claims.text: The hotel is at 25 avenue Montaigne, within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower and the Champs-Elysees.

findings.quote: Our luxury hotel is at 25 avenue Montaigne, 75008 Paris. It's within walking distance of the Eiffel Tower and Champs-Élysées.

claims.text: Avenue Montaigne has a view of the Eiffel Tower at one end and the Champs-Elysees at the other.

findings.quote: Hôtel Plaza Athénée stands proudly on the most sophisticated avenue of Haute Couture, with a view of the Eiffel Tower at one end, and the Champs-Elysées at the other.

claims.text: Avenue Montaigne is home to high-fashion flagships, including number 30, the building where Dior was founded in 1946.

findings.quote: this avenue hosts flagships of high fashion such as number 30, the historic building where Dior was founded in 1946.

claims.text: Le Relais Plaza has original Diane Chasseresse frescoes, a Lalique chandelier and engraved zodiac stained glass.

findings.quote: Look out for Diane Chasseresse’s original frescoes alongside Lalique’s spectacular chandelier and engraved zodiac stained glass.

claims.text: At La Grande Table du Plaza Athenee, the chefs give a fresh take on ancient French recipes, some up to 250 years old.

findings.quote: Our chefs celebrate France’s rich culinary legacy with a fresh take on ancient recipes, some up to 250 years old.

claims.text: Le Cabinet des Conspirateurs is a private dining room set within the kitchen, behind glass doors.

findings.quote: Set within our Michelin-starred kitchen and behind glass doors, a supremely private dining room awaits.

claims.text: Executive pastry chef Angelo Musa won the World Pastry Chef award and was named Meilleur Ouvrier de France in 2007.

findings.quote: Executive pastry chef Angelo Musa is a winner of the World Pastry Chef award and 2007 winner of ‘Meilleur Ouvrier de France’.

claims.text: Afternoon tea is served daily at La Galerie.

findings.quote: Afternoon tea is served daily at La Galerie.

claims.text: La Galerie passes the day to the sound of harps.

findings.quote: happily passing the day under the gentle melodies of harps and soft conversation.

claims.text: Two bakers start the bread at 3am to bring guests fresh rolls every morning.

findings.quote: The life of our bread begins at 3am, as our two bakers knead and shape the dough to bring fresh rolls to our guests every morning.

claims.text: The Dior Light Suite is a light therapy room with circadian-supportive lighting and treatments to help rebalance the sleep cycle.

findings.quote: This unique light therapy room features circadian-supportive lighting alongside curated treatments to help rebalance the sleep cycle and boost energy.

claims.text: Le Bar has a display of Dom Perignon champagnes designed by Nicolas Francart.

findings.quote: The world’s most exclusive Dom Pérignon champagnes, in a striking display designed by Nicolas Francart.

findings.quote: Le Relais Plaza is one of the city’s last remaining Art Deco dining rooms, and its glamorous 1930s spirit lives on.
